claim: Plurality voting over LLM-generated code samples fails as a correctness-verification strategy because LLMs produce correlated errors, meaning voting amplifies shared mistakes rather than catching them.
stance_target: majority/plurality voting as a sufficient zero-hallucination quality-control mechanism
quoted_support: since LLMs are prone to generating correlated errors, this is equivalent to interrogating a group of suspects who have already colluded on the same fake alibi. In such cases, plurality voting does not identify the truth; it merely amplifies their shared deception.

claim: LLM-generated tests and auto-formalized specifications, used as correctness proxies in prior work, are produced by the same imperfect model that wrote the code and thus often corroborate rather than catch errors.
stance_target: same-model-generated tests/specifications as reliable adversarial-review proxies
quoted_support: these proxies are produced by the same imperfect models and thus often corroborate rather than catch errors, especially when the model exhibits correlated errors.

claim: Semantic triangulation increases the probability of selecting a correct program by 16% over baselines (test generation, metamorphic testing, auto-formalized specifications), evaluated on LiveCodeBench and CodeElo across GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemini 2.5 Flash.
stance_target: effectiveness of decorrelated dual-problem consistency checking as a hallucination-reduction technique
scope_conditions: LiveCodeBench, CodeElo benchmarks; GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3, Gemini 2.5 Flash; 2026
quoted_support: our tool increases the probability of selecting a correct program by 16% over baselines (test generation, metamorphic testing, and auto-formalized specifications) and achieves 7% higher reliability and 7% higher F1 score in selection-or-abstention scenarios

claim: Semantic triangulation is reported as the only evaluated method that consistently handles 'inexact' problems admitting multiple valid solutions, a known failure mode for exact-match/test-based correctness proxies.
stance_target: advantage of triangulation-based verification over exact-match test-based verification for open-ended/inexact coding tasks
quoted_support: while being the only method that consistently handles inexact problems admitting multiple valid solutions.

claim: The 'vibe coding' trend, where developers continuously prompt without thoroughly reviewing generated code, exacerbates the risk of undetected bugs and vulnerabilities from LLM hallucination.
stance_target: necessity of automated, decorrelated verification layers given reduced human review in AI-driven coding workflows
quoted_support: This is exacerbated by the growing trend of 'vibe coding', where developers engage in continuous prompting without thoroughly reviewing the generated code.
